lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
No clear effect was seen for adoption and redesign changes across 2 tests, as neither showed a significant win.
Finish and new_flow changes hurt performance across 2 tests, leading to negative effects and one test being stopped early.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results across all tests.

candidates.title: Path Comparison Matrix New Screen
candidates.change: Adds a detailed comparison matrix screen right after path choice to explain differences between ready-made and custom pets.
candidates.why: Funnel shows choose_path drop-off of 23.8% and long mean time (514s) as users hesitate between paths.

new_path_matrix.headline: Choose Your Pet Experience
new_path_matrix.body: Compare pre-made companions versus creating a custom pet.

guard.reason: Adds a valid path comparison screen inside onboarding while retaining all required steps.

candidates.score_note: New screens have historically hurt performance and this lacks support email evidence.

candidates.title: Sign In Account Pet Persistence Hint
candidates.change: Displays a clear hint below sign-in options clarifying that signing in saves and syncs all pet data safely across sessions.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in ensures your pets and custom creations are securely saved to your account.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful persistence hint to the sign-in screen without violating onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign_in drop-off; cheap hint change.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Compact Selection Layout
candidates.change: Switches the pet pick selection grid to a compact card layout for easier scanning of options.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is 60.9% with median time 89s, indicating choice friction during selection.

guard.reason: Redesigns the pet selection layout without removing the ability to choose a pet.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step (39.1%), though only funnel evidence is available.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Troubleshooting New Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated troubleshooting screen during waiting that helps users verify display settings if the desktop pet fails to show.
candidates.why: Support received multiple reports of pets failing to render on the desktop or the app stalling.

new_desktop_help.headline: Desktop Display Verification
new_desktop_help.body: If your pet does not appear on screen, check your system tray and overlay permissions.

guard.reason: Adds an optional troubleshooting screen inside onboarding while preserving all standard steps.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support reports, but introducing a new screen carries high risk of failure.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Progress Time Estimate Info
candidates.change: Enables visible time estimates and progress indicators on the pet initialization screen.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s and mean 2336s, causing user drop-off.

guard.reason: Displays progress indicators and real wait time estimates during pet generation.

candidates.score_note: Addresses massive wait time friction (2336s mean) with low-risk progress info.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Mascot Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a stage layout featuring pet confirmation details.
candidates.why: Adoption step conversion is low (60.9%) and overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%.

guard.reason: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen layout within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 39.1%, but adoption redesigns showed -0.1% lift in past tests.

candidates.title: Home Intro Desktop Controls Copy Clarification
candidates.change: Updates text on the final onboarding screen to concisely explain primary hotkeys and interaction controls.
candidates.why: Support received 3 confusion emails on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop! Right-click your pet anytime to hide, configure controls, or chat.

guard.reason: Updates copy on the home intro overlay, which is part of onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Cheap text update addressing specific support feedback on final onboarding step.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Generation Help Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Adds a photo validation screen before adoption certification to help users avoid pet rendering issues.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking incorrect.

new_photo_checker.headline: Photo Quality Check
new_photo_checker.body: We check your uploaded image for optimal pet generation.

guard.reason: Inserts a photo validation sub-flow screen into onboarding without skipping steps.

candidates.score_note: Sub-flow/new_flow changes hurt performance by -3.8% in past tests.

candidates.title: Story Screen Mascot Greeting Incentive
candidates.change: Adds an encouraging bonus pet accessory badge preview on the story screen to motivate completion.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path before reaching adoption.

guard.reason: Mentions unlocking an exclusive accessory; onboarding copy must not mention gifts, discounts, or free extras.

candidates.title: Pet Ready Desktop Notification Opt-In
candidates.change: Enables optional desktop notifications on the waiting screen when long pet generation completes.
candidates.why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s, leading users to abandon or forget the app while waiting.

waiting.hint: We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready.

guard.reason: Enables an optional notification prompt on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Helps re-engage users abandoning during the 2336s mean wait step.

Sign In Account Pet Persistence Hint
Home Intro Desktop Controls Copy Clarification
lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as well as adoption and new_flow changes, as only one test has been completed for each.
No clear effect was seen for adoption and redesign changes across 2 tests.
Finish and new_flow changes hurt performance across 2 tests, resulting in negative noise-corrected effects and one test stopped early.
Predictions were consistently too high compared to noise-corrected results across all tests.
